newsitem.title: UK: ARA BUNKERS SLIP BY $1, GAS OIL DOWN $1-$2.
newsitem.headline: ARA BUNKERS SLIP BY $1, GAS OIL DOWN $1-$2.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices were slightly weaker on Monday amid a lack of enquiry for product, traders said.

Delivered Rotterdam 380 cst bunker prices were talked around $97 a tonne while 180 cst material was worth around $101. Dealers said that while demand was scant, supply was scarce too and activity was limited.
Diesel oil and gas oil bunkers were weaker in most bunkering centres, in line with September IPE futures which shed $1.25 a tonne to stand at around $168.25 by mid-afternoon.
But Brent crude futures were almost unchanged at around $18.45.
